prompt: The back of a trading card for Mythologica, a card game of world mythologies, seen perfectly flat and straight-on, filling the whole image: a sleek, minimal design. A deep, dark sea-blue field with a subtle worn texture, one thin bronze border inset from the edge with small, simple corner ornaments, and a plain, slightly darker circular medallion in the centre, left empty for an emblem. Elegant and restrained, with lots of empty space; not busy, no patterns filling the field. Hand-painted matte finish, lightly worn like an old card. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo.
